# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_RIBBON_EXTENSION_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Expanding bullish ribbon spread (8EMA-21EMA rising for three consecutive bars) between 11:30-13:00 ET, with price above 21EMA, signals trend resumption after lunch lull. This captures edge from institutional re-entry post-liquidity vacuum, where short-term momentum re-aligns with intermediate trend as retail participation returns.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Between 11:30 and 13:00 ET, if 8EMA > 21EMA, the difference (8EMA‑21EMA) has risen for three consecutive 5-minute bars, and price closes above the 21EMA, go long at the close of that bar.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at recent swing low prior to entry, initial target 1.5×R, runner trailed 15% from highest close.  
**Regime filter:** Only active when VIX < 22 and ADX > 20 (avoiding choppy/flat ribbon conditions).
